name: wordmark-cut
title: Wordmark Cut
description: A wordmark twice the width of the frame, cooling from a lit gradient to ink while it settles, and then a hard cut onto its last letters and the dot — 1.71× nearer, with a shallow depth of field the wide shot does not have, which is the only thing that says the second shot is closer rather than just bigger. It holds a beat and pushes in, still accelerating on the last frame.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/wordmark-cut?ref=cli — pass word for the wordmark and dotFrom/dotTo for the gradient.
